title: Last name is required
why: Confirms that a blank last name is rejected even when everything else is valid.

steps.does: POST …/identity/register-user with LastName '' (blank). FirstName Anna, Email anna.meyer@example.com, UserName anna.meyer, PassPortNumber DE9876543, Password Str0ng!Pass1, matching ConfirmPassword.

expect: Rejected with a validation error naming LastName as required. No User row is created.
